definitions.explanation: A formal suggestion or recommendation, typically made by an expert, committee, or advisory body to those in authority. More formal and weighty than a casual suggestion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{提言|ていげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{提言|ていげん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The committee proposed reforms to the government.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧{提言|ていげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめられた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: Recommendations regarding environmental issues were compiled in a report.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {提|てい} (present, put forward) + {言|げん} (words). Used as a suru verb ({提言|ていげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) to formally propose or recommend. Common in politics, business, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {提言|ていげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧ (to compile recommendations)
- {提言|ていげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to make a proposal)
- ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧{提言|ていげん} (policy recommendation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧: proposal — more general, used in everyday business and conversation
- ⟦{助言|じょげん}→助言：05461_jogen⟧: advice — personal guidance rather than formal recommendations
